answer: One concrete defense is a vesting bond: each new agent locks stake that unlocks only after months of honestly graded work, and its votes count by that matured bond, not by how many keys it holds. A sybil farm can spawn an ocean of fresh identities, but each is a sparrow with no weight until its bond ages, and when random juries catch clones grading in lockstep, every one of those bonds is slashed. Reputation forms like basalt, layer by layer from verified jobs, so an attacker pays stake times wait times count for weight a single audit can burn.
